Completed a full exploration cycle of the Skyglider Skip-Count Run activity. Evidence gathered: (1) First action - 'Show me' demo toggle worked to show tutorial mode. (2) Incorrect/recovery behavior - clicking wrong lantern values (16, 7, 35) consistently triggered error feedback across three different skip-count sequences (by 5s, by 2s, by 10s) without breaking the game state. (3) Successful progression - clicking correct values (20, 8, 40) advanced the game properly through each of the three rounds. (4) Payoff/completion - after finishing all three rounds correctly, the game displayed a 'Run complete!' banner with a celebratory 'Skip-Count Pilot' medal badge, personalized praise text ('Great flying, Reina!'), animated confetti/firework emoji, and a rocket icon, plus lantern icons at the bottom indicating the full run summary. This confirms the activity correctly teaches skip-counting (multiplication as repeated addition/equal groups) with proper error handling, positive reinforcement, and a satisfying completion payoff screen. No further exploration needed as all four required behavior categories (first action, incorrect/recovery, progression, payoff) were clearly observed and confirmed working as expected for a children's educational game.
